svg.title: Fig 4 — run timeline, metered tokens by role
svg.desc: Cumulative metered tokens against wall-clock UTC for the whole session, stacked by role: worker, reviewer and one improvement call. Every call belongs to one of seven labelled run bands, the cumulative totals stated by the run artefacts are marked, and the axis is broken across the fifty-minute gap in which no calls were metered.
svg.text: Run timeline — cumulative metered tokens by role

calls 65–72 · structural comparison, candidate reviewer-v2 · 44 070 tokens
cumulative total stated by a run summary
USD unknown: prices {} — accounting_method=tokens (budget.py never converts tokens to a dollar figure)
the cap is off this scale: 437 399 metered against a session cap of 2 000 000 tokens (21.9%)
the time axis is broken at the fifty-minute gap and the two segments are scaled separately; within a segment the scale is linear and the tick labels carry the real times
every metered call belongs to one of the seven bands; the roles are the ledger's own role field, and the band totals are sums over it
